_source: CoreAdmin STATUS after a failed RELOAD of the search core, constructed from Solr 9.8.1's CoreContainer.reload (the failure goes into initFailures, the old core stays registered and serving) and StatusOp (status lists getAllCoreNames(), sorted, plus initFailures). The message is illustrative.

initFailures.search: org.apache.solr.common.SolrException: Could not load conf for core search: Can't load schema managed-schema.xml: [schema.xml] Duplicate field definition for 'dc.title'
